sermons.title: Sermon 1967 | Plain Gospel For Plain People

scripture.verse: "For this commandment which I command you this day, it is not hidden fromyou, neither is it far off. It is not in Heaven, that you should say, Who shall go up for us to Heaven and bringit unto us, that we may hear it and do it? Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall go over the sea for us and bring it unto us, that we may hear it and do it? But the Word is very near unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it."

sermons.title: Sermon 1968 | Jubilee Joy—or, Believers Joyful In Their King

scripture.verse: "Let the children of Zion bejoyful in their King."
"Remember the Word unto Your servant upon which You have caused me to hope."

sermons.title: Sermon 1971 | The Blood Shed For Many

scripture.verse: "For this is My blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins."

sermons.title: Sermon 1972 | A Bit of History for Old and Young

scripture.verse: "And he blessed Joseph and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day, the Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads."
"Though He is not far from each one of us."
"All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep His Co venant and His testimonies."
